name: Cerca Magnetics OPM-MEG System
deployment: 128-sensor system tested with UCL. Phase-2 clinical trials for childhood epilepsy and autism research. UK government £14M+ quantum sensing program includes Cerca.
bci_relevance: Second leading OPM-MEG platform. 128 channels vs QuSpin's 50 in largest array. Not accessible to independent researcher but validates OPM-MEG for paediatric BCI (movement-tolerant).
